method: Exact functional ANOVA of complete categorical factorial table; independent uniform mass on the enumerated levels, separately for p=5,10,15
limits: Scenario variance, not calibrated uncertainty or confidence intervals
Deletion and displacement each have one fixed realization per factorial level
Not a continuous-parameter Monte Carlo Sobol estimator
Speed uncertainty, road additions and environmental grid factors are outside this covering experiment
Total-effect shares overlap through interactions and must not be summed
